name: Steal Or Die [UPDATE!]
desc:
🔦Escape the monster,  steal loot — or BE the monster

You have minutes to loot the building. Something is hunting you the whole time.

💰 STEAL — 31 items to grab, from phones to gold bars. The rarer the loot, the bigger the payout… and the slower you run.
🚪 HIDE — closets, vents, barricaded doors. It hears your footsteps. It hears your voice.
👹 OR BE THE MONSTER — play as the entity and hunt your friends.

[VERSION 1.45]: MANY IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES + FACILITY AND OFFICE MAP EXPANSIONS

★ 4 maps: Facility, Office, American Dorm and Supermarket!
★ 4 entities: The Locust, The Hollow and etc...
★ Skill trees, upgrades and 10 rebirths
★ Cases, skins, emotes and trading
★ Rare events: FULL BLACKOUT, BLOODBATH, MALFUNCTION...
★ Lobby basketball with 1v1s

🥽 FULL VR SUPPORT — real hands, real crouching, real fear.
📱 FULL PHONE & TABLET SUPPORT — custom touch controls built for mobile.
🖥️ PC, of course.
🎮 CONSOLE

Bring friends. Don't trust them.

👍 Like and favourite for updates!

llm.loop: enter a building -> grab loot while an entity hunts you -> hide and escape before time runs out -> spend cash on upgrades, cases and rebirths (or play as the monster)
llm.objectives: steal the most valuable loot and escape alive, or hunt players as the entity
llm.progression: cash, skill trees, upgrades, 10 rebirths, cases/skins
llm.instructions: loot the building in minutes, hide in closets/vents, avoid the monster that hears footsteps and voice; or be the monster
llm.thumbnails: dark horror stills: red toothy creature icon, 'IT WON'T LET YOU GO', creature lunging, found-footage 'THE LOCUST' camera shot
llm.complexity_notes: 4 maps, 4 AI entities, asymmetric mode, VR and console support, skill trees, trading and cases
